blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Higher metal prices nearly doubled OceanaGold Philippines Inc.’s (OGP) net profit in the nine months ending September, despite lower sales and production. The local unit of Australian-Canadian mining company OceanaGold Corp. reported a net income of $95.6 million from January to September, a 95-percent surge from the same period a year ago. READ: OceanaGold’s Jan-Jun bottom line ballooned by 206% Revenue rose 37 percent to $434.4 million, as higher gold and copper prices offset lower sales, making this the main driver of revenue growth.
